text:
Rae: Seeing a drift on postmortem action items. proposing a compact follow-up flow: owner-ack within 48h, short 10d remediation sprint, and a 6-week recurrence check.
Diego: +1. shorter windows make it easier to nudge people. can we require owner to include an ETA and estimated dev hours in the ack?
Zara: yes please. suggested ack format: "Ack. Impact: med. ETA: 3d. Est hrs: 8. Blockers: none."
Rae: idea for automation: ops-bot creates a minimal checklist at T+0 and pings owner at 48h and sprint end at T+10d. also tag Jira tickets with label pm-action so dashboards pick them up.
ops-bot: Checklist created in #private-action-tracker for thread 1977777777. Reminders scheduled: T+48h, T+10d.
Diego: rotation note: keep IC rotation to 1 week, but require IC be listed on the postmortem root so follow-ups know who to ping. if remediation spans >7d, IC leaves a handoff note.
Zara: comms cadence: eng channel gets 48h ack + 10d closure. execs only get weekly digest for high-impact incidents. keep messages 1 line.
EngManager: Good plan. pilot this for next 6 incidents and measure: % owner ack within 48h, % remediations closed by 10d, recurrence at 6 weeks. Rae, can you own pilot coordination?
Rae: I can. will draft a compact template and paste it into the incident doc. example template: Owner, Backup, Impact, ETA, Est hrs, T+48h ack, T+10d close/extend, T+42d replay, T+42-56d recurrence review.
Diego: add a suggested T+48h canned message for consistency.
Rae: added. will run pilot and report metrics after 6 incidents. :white_check_mark:
